summary: KT Corporation's Form 6-K filing contains its second-quarter 2026 earnings release, presenting financial highlights, operating results, and business overview. The filing reports a decline in operating income due to a prior-year real estate project base effect, while revenue and margins are detailed on a K-IFRS basis. It also mentions a shareholder return value-up plan announced on August 12, 2026, including a KRW 250bn share buyback and cancellation program. The content is routine quarterly reporting with no special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or management change. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
